$comment: Rebuilt from the real product mockups the owner provided (pre-ship qualification sticker, build-instruction reference sheet, and the NestForge Studio app home screen). Every field is tagged CONFIRMED (came directly from those source images) or an explicit ASSUMPTION/PLACEHOLDER (a reasonable implementation choice made where the sources don't give exact numbers). See docs/DECISIONS.md 'Mockup reconciliation' section for the full writeup.
